name: hsm-selection-spike
title: HSM selection spike
description: Prototype the required lifecycle HSM in statig and a direct enum reference, measure host-visible tradeoffs, and record one production selection without hardware dependencies.
scope: host-only statig versus direct-enum lifecycle HSM comparison and production selection
creator: mj
notes: Software-only G1 child complete. A development-only harness compares exhaustive direct-enum and no-macro statig 0.4.1 candidates across the same eight-state/twelve-event contract. Seven unit tests plus one process-output test prove identical projections, global E-stop, ordered Running cancellation, restart inhibition, deterministic 96-row/DOT output and zero allocations. Release host evidence records equal workload checksums; direct enum uses 1,648 fewer file bytes, 808 fewer text bytes and 108 versus 343 source lines. Source inspection and a regression test record statig's reversed before_transition arguments; the optional macro path's future-incompatible dependency was removed before final CI. Direct enum is selected for production G2. Final tools/ci.sh passed without the future-incompat warning. Hardware, Orange Pi, target timing and G2 implementation remain open.
